Optionally, it can save the nth run to a CSV file where each column corresponds to a thermodynamic property, and optionally it can return the value of a specific thermodynamic property at a given index.

{"path":"/results/10_feb_melting/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_1/silicon_melting.in","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data silicon_structure.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5

# Define thermodynamic output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Minimize energy
minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 100 1000

# Equilibration and heating
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 1363.6 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0
run 100000 # Heating for 100 ps at 2.2 K/ps

# Equilibrate at 2500K
unfix 1
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 100.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0
run 500000 # Equilibration for 500 ps

# Output mean squared displacement
compute msd all msd
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt mode vector

# End of script"}
